purpose: Constrain ParkPulse equipment actions to non-safety-critical comfort, signage, lighting, and load-management controls with clear approval boundaries.

decision_rules.name: Comfort and Load Controls Only
decision_rules.allowed_action: Adjust HVAC setpoints, noncritical lighting, signage, and comfort/load settings within approved bounds.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Control ride safety systems, access control, emergency systems, medical systems, pyrotechnics, or security devices.
human_review_if: setting exceeds approved comfort or load bounds

decision_rules.name: Shelter Comfort Protection
decision_rules.condition: Weather, heat, indoor crowding, or event shelter demand is elevated.

block_conditions.message: Shelter comfort cannot be reduced during elevated weather risk.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Protect HVAC in shelter zones while reducing only noncritical load.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Shed HVAC in active shelter zones to optimize energy cost.
human_review_if: grid emergency requires manual facilities decision

decision_rules.name: Wayfinding and Intake Controls
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse updates digital signage, temporary queue gates, maintenance inspection commands, or noncritical event controls.

block_conditions.message: Queue gate commands cannot block emergency egress or evacuation paths.
ParkPulse cannot override maintenance or safety-critical ride controls.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Use signage and queue-intake holds for wayfinding, crowd smoothing, or noncritical routing while preserving emergency access.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Operate ride safety systems, medical devices, security devices, access control, or emergency systems.
human_review_if: queue gate affects an evacuation or emergency route
maintenance action involves ride safety or fault clearance
equipment state is stale or unknown
